title: We Had to End It
lyrics:
[01:02.26]Me and my lover came to an end
[01:11.07]I didn't want that
[01:14.85]But I guess she did
[01:22.09]Sleepless nights have only begun
[01:30.77]Swear I thought she was the one
[01:35.96]The girl of my dreams
[01:42.78]All my nightmares came to ruin my life
[01:51.67]Mercy had no time
[01:55.16]And time had no mercy on me
[02:02.93]I felt so dumb thinking one day you could be my wife
[02:11.78]Never thought you would lie
[02:17.02]When you said you loved me
[03:05.16]Nothing can bring me back to life
[03:12.75]After you left me to die
[03:18.69]On a road far away
[03:25.59]Love and lies shine so bright
[03:34.08]'Cause they both made me blind
[03:37.90]And I crashed as I looked away
[03:46.13]Ghost of my past haunts my present
[03:54.63]As there he welcomed
[03:59.90]My agony and pain
[04:06.35]He said, I'll be gone before you know
[04:15.12]Just finish this song
[04:19.06]And you'll be where you belong
